        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Confirm</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Reject</bpmn:flowNodeRef>

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_Rejected</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Change" name="Change of master data" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TellINQ" name="Tell the INQ about the change of master data" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="Start_Change" targetRef="Task_TellINQ" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_TellINQ" targetRef="Task_NotifyIP" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Task_NotifyIP" targetRef="Task_Check" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Task_Check" targetRef="Gw_Possible" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8" sourceRef="Task_Reject" targetRef="End_Rejected" />
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
